summary: Dossier re-plan needed for orphic-hymns after front-matter drop: 138→103 chunks breaks c8 span freeze

analysis.author: corpus-quality
analysis.content:
DRIVER FINDING (2026-08-20): The dossier stream for orphic-hymns (campaign c8, all D1-D5 complete) is built ON the front-matter chunks that df44bdeb is dropping. After the ingest re-chunk (138→103 chunks), this is a freeze violation:

- work_dossiers.structure_json has spans like 'Front Matter, p. 1 – 3' / 'Title Page, Preface, and Dissertation I' — 6 of 13 L1 spans are front-matter summaries about content being removed
- summary_nodes: 14 rows referencing old 001-138 chunk ids (including 35 to-be-dropped)
- staged_summaries: 26 rows with child_chunk_ids JSON pointing at old chunk ids
- work_dossiers: 1 row with structure_json child_chunk_ids pointing at old chunk ids
- staged_cleanups: 1 row on chunk .001 (becomes moot when .001 is dropped)

apparatus_remap.py (COLS list) does NOT cover: summary_nodes.child_chunk_ids, staged_summaries.child_chunk_ids, work_dossiers.structure_json, or staged_cleanups.chunk_id — these will reference dead/renumbered ids after the remap lands.

Per dossier rules (docs/dossiers/#span-plan-is-a-freeze-artifact): a corpus change that alters totals means a NEW campaign (c8→c9) and full re-plan/generate/review/promote/embed cycle. The front-matter summaries are about content that no longer exists — they cannot be remapped, only regenerated.
